rationale: Both Sunil and Sen are full-stack engineers with overlapping expertise in TypeScript, Python, and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js), but bring complementary strengths—Sunil's AI and blockchain focus pairs well with Sen's developer-tools and web specialization. This combination of shared technical foundation and complementary domain expertise could spark interesting collaboration on projects bridging AI/blockchain with robust web infrastructure.
intro_message: Sunil Kumar Chavhan, meet Sen Thotawatte — you both code across TypeScript and Python, but Sunil brings AI and blockchain depth while Sen specializes in full-stack web and developer tools, making you natural collaborators for cross-domain projects.
